template.event: if (element:GetComponent("Text"):GetVar("visible"):GetInt() > 0) then local totalTimeLength = 0.75 local curTime = element:GetVar("time") local time = curTime:GetFloat() curTime:SetFloat(time + dt) time = curTime:GetFloat() while(time > totalTimeLength) do curTime:SetFloat(time - totalTimeLength) time = curTime:GetFloat() end if (time > 0) then if (time > totalTimeLength/2) then local t = (time - totalTimeLength/2)/(totalTimeLength/2) menu:SetElementComponentVarFloat(element:name(), "Text", "red", 1.0) menu:SetElementComponentVarFloat(element:name(), "Text", "green", 1.0 - t) menu:SetElementComponentVarFloat(element:name(), "Text", "blue", 1.0 - t) else local t = (time)/(totalTimeLength/2) menu:SetElementComponentVarFloat(element:name(), "Text", "red", 1.0) menu:SetElementComponentVarFloat(element:name(), "Text", "green", t) menu:SetElementComponentVarFloat(element:name(), "Text", "blue", 0) end end end
